longForm.overview:
👨‍🔧 is the emoji of wrench-coded 'under the hood' reveal — a man mechanic with coveralls and tool, the iconography of repair, repair-coded energy, and the universal 'fix it mode' tag. Where 👩‍🔧 reads as mechanic-coded female-fix and 🧑‍🔧 reads as mechanic-coded neutral-fix, 👨‍🔧 captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate wrench-coded flex — a 'fix together 👨‍🔧' partner moment or a 'under the hood 👨‍🔧' repair-coded reveal. The man mechanic cue borrows from the universal repair tradition and the modern wrench-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as wrench-coded rather than literal profession.

In real-world usage 👨‍🔧 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate repair-coded energy. A partner sends it on a 'fix together 👨‍🔧' check-in. A friend sends it on a 'under the hood 👨‍🔧' reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'fix it mode 👨‍🔧' coded message. The man mechanic cue is what makes the emoji feel wrench-coded — it is not just 'mechanic,' it is 'mechanic-coded repair moment.'

What separates 👨‍🔧 from the rest of the person-role family is the repair-coded register. The emoji is not saying 'woman mechanic' (👩‍🔧), 'man pilot' (👨‍✈️), or 'man farmer' (👨‍🌾). It is saying 'wrench-coded under the hood,' which carries a specific repair tradition. That is why 👨‍🔧 travels especially well on partner 'fix together' check-ins, repair reveals, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with wrench-coded energy.
